integrity: Complete self-contained graph constructions and exact checks from two independent standard-library scripts; finite enumeration supplements a symbolic lower bound and quotient proof.
scientific_limitations: Single finite graph; complete exhaustive computation validates 4845 size-four candidates but does not generalize to other graphs. Originality could be affected by unindexed historical computations or the unavailable full-text Yi paper.
title: Antipodal edge lifts classify disjunctive total domination on the dodecahedral graph
